verdict.rationale: Only community comments show a free tier exists: users mention the free allotment they get ('the 20 gigabyte they give you for free') and a 'free until it isn't' upsell once space runs out. No first-party doc in the pack publishes a free-tier quota or confirms free accounts use the same sync clients and Graph API, though the docs describe a single Graph API for OneDrive generally. Missing for 10: first-party published free storage quota, explicit confirmation that free accounts get the same clients and Graph API access, independent verification of the quota figure.
